designationHistory.name: Clear Lake Reservation
designationHistory.indexText: William Howard Taft signed Executive Order 1332 creating the Clear Lake Reservation in northeastern California as a preserve and breeding ground for native birds.
designationHistory.note: Taft's 1912 order confirms the creation date. The text of Executive Order 1332 itself was not read. Renamed Clear Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416 (July 25, 1940).

sources.name: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Lower Klamath, Clear Lake, Tule Lake, Upper Klamath and Bear Valley NWRs CCP/EIS, 2016 (ServCat 114424)

Wikisource transcription of Executive Order 1464 (Jan. 13, 1912), which reduces 'the Clear Lake Reservation, California, created by Executive Order dated April 11, 1911' (from a period government printing)
